description: Conditions, barometer trend, forecast, tide and space weather. All of it externally sourced -- this boat has no masthead unit.

SELECT ts AS time, (value - 273.15) * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0 AS value
FROM signalk
WHERE path = 'environment.outside.temperature' AND context = 'self' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1
